definition: A commitment to reduce energy consumption or improve the energy performance of ICT equipment, networks, systems or operations: energy-efficient equipment, efficiency standards in specifications, fibre replacing copper where energy is the stated reason, efficient cooling, software optimization, energy management systems. Counts when the efficiency improvement is financed or required. A data centre's own energy and cooling performance is a separate measure (green data centres). Does not count: a modernization with no energy aim stated.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
